source: 950DT, official PA_BBND QSLI provider, one active AIC with two AIVs, 32 consecutive 512-key tiles, PA table width 8201. Span from first to last MMAD_MX issue. calibration/candidate_indexer/qsli-one-team.json
scope: Effective team loop issue interval in cycles including gather, ring and dependencies. Used only between tiles of the same row fragment on the scalar address path. Not a memory-load latency. Other SKUs inherit this control rate subject to their resource floors.
split_row_source: Pooled 950DT + PR compiled QSLI stage landmarks, not window regression. See calibration/candidate_indexer/v112_merge.json and its trace decoder. Durations in cycles, input count per radix group 256, full partial list top512.
parallel_row_issue_source: v113_mechanism.json, per-AIC MMAD intervals in device cycles. First-fragment endpoints use the original DT shared and dispersed first rows. The prefetched same-document row interval uses only the original dispersed DT second row and is subject to target resource floors. Handoff averages the DT/PR trace medians. First control is the median of three earliest native MMAD offsets less the modeled initial gather, publish and Cube read. Causal contributions of cache and bank conflicts are unidentified.
